 2026 DII men's soccer championship: Bracket, schedule, scores
 Hat trick, red card, 2OT drama in DII men's soccer first round 
 Share 
 Here’s everything you need to know about the 2026 DII men's soccer championship. The championship is underway, with the third round kicking off Friday, Nov. 20. 
 Watch live: 2026 DII men's soccer championship 
 The 40-team championship bracket was revealed during a selection show on Monday, Nov. 9 on NCAA.com .
 The Men’s Soccer Committee selected 10 teams from each of the four super-regions to participate in first, second, third and quarterfinal rounds of the tournament to determine the four regional champions. The regional champions advance to the semifinals and finals of the championship, and each will be seeded using the available selection criteria to determine matchups.  Click or tap here for the press release .
